name: User - Unclear Preview/Submit Selection
goal: Test that the bot prompts for clarification if the user's input at preview/submit is unclear.
constraints: User enters ambiguous input at Step 6.

phases.description: User enters unclear input at preview/submit step.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot prompts for clarification and proceeds based on clarified input.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
